items.title: Blue chips steer ASX to gains
items.summary: Australian blue chips have driven the ASX 200 up 0.8 per cent, with banks and miners leading gains, while Telstra and lithium stocks dragged.

items.title: Stock Market Today, Oct. 12: Dow Gains as Memory Stocks Weigh on Nasdaq
items.summary: On Oct. 12, 2026, investors brace for bank earnings while semiconductor weakness pressures the broader market.

items.title: Stock Market Today, Oct. 12: Iren Surges on Reports of Anthropic Cloud Services Deal
items.summary: On Oct. 12, 2026, the AI infrastructure operator reportedly signed a multiyear agreement with Anthropic, reinforcing its pivot away from legacy mining operations.

aus.headline: Banks, Miners Lift The ASX
aus.body: The ASX 200 rose 0.8% as banks and miners led, while Telstra and lithium lagged.
aus.why: A broad lift for the biggest companies on the local sharemarket.

us.headline: Memory Chips Weigh On Nasdaq
us.body: The Dow gained while weakness in memory chip stocks pulled on the Nasdaq.
us.why: US bank earnings are next on the calendar for investors.

biz.headline: Iren Jumps On Anthropic Deal Report
biz.body: Iren shares surged on reports it signed a multiyear cloud deal with Anthropic.
biz.why: It marks a pivot for Iren from legacy mining to AI infrastructure.
